techStack: Runtime: Node.js with Express v5, ESM modules (type: module)
Database: better-sqlite3 v12 — synchronous SQLite, raw SQL with ? placeholders, no ORM or query builder
Test framework: Vitest v4 with supertest for HTTP integration tests
TypeScript ~6.0, strict-equivalent flags (noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters, etc.), no ESLint/Prettier
In-memory SQLite DB used when NODE_ENV=test; disk DB otherwise
features: GET /products supports filters: search (LIKE), category (exact), inStock (bool), sort (allowlisted map); featured not in SQL
Pagination envelope: { total, page, limit, totalPages, data }; limit clamped to max 50
products.test.ts: covers category filter (4 electronics), inStock filter (11 in-stock), empty results, sort orders, auth, envelope shape
pagination.test.ts: asserts totalPages=2 for 15 products at limit=10, totalPages=3 for limit=5
getFeaturedProducts() is a separate export using LEFT JOIN featured_overrides — unrelated to getProducts()
Auth middleware rejects tokens whose digit-sum is odd; /health is exempt
architecture: Layer order: routes -> controllers -> services -> db (all static ES module imports, no DI framework)
productRoutes.ts -> productController.ts -> productService.getProducts() -> db singleton from db/client.ts
SQL style: raw parameterized strings, conditions[] array joined with AND, params[] array passed to .all()/.get()
WHERE clause already built at line 48 via: conditions.length ? `WHERE ${conditions.join(' AND ')}` : ''
New filter conditions belong in the if-blocks between lines 31-47 (before the where variable is composed)
COUNT query at line 56-58 must receive the same where string and params as the SELECT query at line 61
edgeCases: total=0: Math.ceil(0/limit)=0 — safe, no division-by-zero or NaN
Exact divisibility (e.g. 15/5=3): Math.ceil and Math.floor agree — bug only surfaces when total%limit != 0
featured AND other filters: existing AND join in conditions[] is correct — intersection semantics required
No active filters: conditions=[], where='', both COUNT and SELECT run without WHERE — base case unchanged
featured=false must also be handled: query.featured !== undefined check needed (not just truthiness), already the gate in existing code
Post-pagination JS filter for featured on a limit=3 slice returns <3 results — removing it and moving to SQL fixes requirement 5 and 10
